items.headline: Federal Court Ruling Upholds Lack of Evidence for Designating Certain Products as High-Risk Imports.
items.teaser: A federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration still lacks sufficient evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply chain risk…
items.story:
A federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration still lacks sufficient evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply chain risk, dealing a significant blow to the government's efforts to ban the company's AI technology. The decision, made in a US federal court, highlights the ongoing dispute between the government and Anthropic over the company's alleged ties to potential security threats. This ruling marks a major development in the case, which has been ongoing for several months. The judge's decision is expected to have significant implications for the future of Anthropic's operations in the US.

The Trump administration's concerns about Anthropic's supply chain risk stem from the company's alleged connections to entities with potential ties to foreign governments. The government has argued that these connections pose a significant threat to national security, citing the potential for sensitive information to be compromised. However, Anthropic has consistently denied these allegations, arguing that the government's concerns are unfounded and based on incomplete information. The company has maintained that its technology is designed with robust security measures to prevent any potential risks.

According to court documents, the judge found that the government had not presented sufficient evidence to support its claims about Anthropic's supply chain risk. The judge noted that the government's allegations were based on incomplete and unsubstantiated information, and that Anthropic had provided convincing evidence to refute these claims. The ruling highlights the need for the government to provide more concrete evidence to support its allegations, and raises questions about the credibility of the government's claims. The judge's decision is seen as a significant victory for Anthropic, which has been fighting to clear its name and protect its business interests.

The ruling has been met with mixed reactions from stakeholders and industry experts. Some have welcomed the decision, arguing that it highlights the need for the government to provide more robust evidence to support its claims. Others have expressed concern that the ruling may undermine the government's efforts to protect national security. Anthropic's competitors have also been watching the case closely, as the outcome has significant implications for the broader AI industry. The ruling is expected to have a ripple effect on the industry, with many companies likely to re-examine their own supply chain risks and security measures.

The case has broader implications for the US government's approach to regulating AI technology and managing supply chain risks. The ruling highlights the need for the government to strike a balance between protecting national security and promoting innovation in the tech industry. The US government has been under pressure to take a tougher stance on companies with alleged ties to foreign governments, but this ruling suggests that a more nuanced approach may be needed. The case also raises questions about the effectiveness of the government's current regulatory framework, and whether it is equipped to handle the complex security risks associated with emerging technologies like AI.

As the case moves forward, attention will turn to the government's next steps and whether it will appeal the ruling. Anthropic is likely to continue to push for a full clearance of its name and a lifting of the ban on its AI technology. The company may also seek to recover damages or compensation for the harm caused to its business by the government's allegations. The outcome of the case will be closely watched by industry experts and stakeholders, who will be looking for clarity on the government's approach to regulating AI technology and managing supply chain risks. The ruling is likely to have a lasting impact on the AI industry, and may shape the course of future regulatory decisions.

items.headline: Healthcare firm CareCloud alerts patients after massive data breach compromise.
items.teaser: CareCloud, a major health tech company, has begun notifying hundreds of thousands of individuals that their medical records were stolen b…
items.story:
CareCloud, a major health tech company, has begun notifying hundreds of thousands of individuals that their medical records were stolen by hackers who breached one of its protected health data stores. The incident occurred recently, although the exact timeline is not yet clear. CareCloud handles vast amounts of sensitive patient data, making it a significant target for cybercriminals. The company is working to notify affected individuals and provide them with support and resources to protect their personal information.

The breach is a significant concern due to the sensitive nature of the data involved, which includes medical records and other personal health information. CareCloud is a leading provider of cloud-based healthcare services, and its systems are used by numerous healthcare providers and medical organizations. The company has a long history of handling sensitive data, and this incident raises questions about the effectiveness of its security measures. The breach also highlights the growing threat of cyberattacks on healthcare organizations, which have become increasingly reliant on digital systems to store and manage patient data.

According to official statements, the hackers gained unauthorized access to one of CareCloud's protected health data stores, compromising the personal and medical information of hundreds of thousands of individuals. The company has not disclosed the exact number of affected individuals or the specific data that was stolen. However, it has confirmed that it is working closely with law enforcement and cybersecurity experts to investigate the incident and prevent similar breaches in the future. CareCloud has also established a dedicated support line for affected individuals, providing them with guidance on how to protect their personal information and prevent identity theft.

The breach has sparked concerns among patients and healthcare providers, who are worried about the potential consequences of their sensitive data being compromised. Many are questioning the security measures in place at CareCloud and other healthcare organizations, and some are calling for greater transparency and accountability. The incident has also raised concerns about the potential for medical identity theft, which can have serious consequences for affected individuals. As the investigation into the breach continues, stakeholders are eagerly awaiting more information about the incident and the steps being taken to prevent similar breaches in the future.

The breach at CareCloud is part of a larger trend of cyberattacks on healthcare organizations, which have become increasingly vulnerable to digital threats. In recent years, numerous healthcare companies have reported significant data breaches, resulting in the compromise of millions of patient records. The trend has raised concerns about the need for greater investment in cybersecurity measures and more stringent regulations to protect sensitive patient data. As the healthcare industry becomes increasingly reliant on digital systems, the risk of cyberattacks is likely to grow, making it essential for organizations to prioritize cybersecurity and protect patient data.

As the investigation into the CareCloud breach continues, the company is likely to face scrutiny from regulators and lawmakers, who will be examining the incident to determine whether the company took adequate steps to protect patient data. The incident may also lead to changes in the way healthcare organizations approach cybersecurity, with a greater emphasis on prevention and response. In the coming weeks and months, affected individuals will be watching closely to see how the incident is handled and what steps are taken to prevent similar breaches in the future. The breach serves as a reminder of the importance of prioritizing cybersecurity in the healthcare industry and the need for ongoing vigilance to protect sensitive patient data.

items.story:

This development comes after GOP Sens. Thom Tillis of North Carolina and John Cornyn of Texas expressed concerns about Blanche's nomination, stalling the process. Trump's statement puts pressure on his critics to reconsider their stance, as he believes Blanche is the right person for the job. The president's willingness to delay the nomination is seen as a strategic move to ensure Blanche's confirmation.

The nomination of Todd Blanche as Attorney General has been a contentious issue, with some Republican senators expressing reservations about his suitability for the role. The delay in his confirmation has sparked a heated debate about the future of the Department of Justice and the impact of Blanche's potential leadership on the agency. Trump's support for Blanche has been unwavering, with the president praising his nominee as a "star" and a highly qualified individual. The nomination process has highlighted the deep divisions within the Republican Party, with some senators opposing Blanche's confirmation due to concerns about his experience and qualifications.

According to Trump, delaying Blanche's nomination would be the "right thing" to do, given the opposition from some Republican senators. The president has emphasized that he has "no objection" to temporarily withdrawing the nomination until his opponents are out of office. This statement has been seen as a warning to Sens. Tillis and Cornyn, who have been vocal about their concerns regarding Blanche's nomination. Trump's comments have also sparked speculation about the future of the Department of Justice and the potential implications of Blanche's confirmation on the agency's policies and direction.

The reaction to Trump's statement has been mixed, with some Republican senators welcoming the possibility of delaying Blanche's nomination. Others have expressed concern that the delay could create uncertainty and undermine the stability of the Department of Justice. Democratic senators have been critical of Trump's move, arguing that it is an attempt to strong-arm his opponents and push through a nomination that lacks broad support. The public response to the development has been largely divided, with some people expressing support for Trump's decision and others criticizing the move as an example of partisan politics.

The controversy surrounding Blanche's nomination is part of a broader debate about the role of the Department of Justice and the impact of political appointments on the agency's independence. The nomination process has highlighted the challenges faced by the Trump administration in filling key positions, with some nominees facing opposition from both Democrats and Republicans. The delay in Blanche's nomination has also raised questions about the future of the Department of Justice and the potential implications of Trump's policies on the agency's operations and priorities.

As the nomination process continues, it remains to be seen whether Trump will follow through on his threat to delay Blanche's nomination. The decision will depend on various factors, including the level of opposition from Republican senators and the potential consequences of delaying the nomination. The outcome of the nomination process will have significant implications for the Department of Justice and the Trump administration, with the potential to shape the agency's policies and direction for years to come. The situation is being closely watched by lawmakers, policymakers, and the public, as the fate of Blanche's nomination hangs in the balance.

items.headline: Voter anxiety intensifies ahead of pivotal November election, new survey indicates.
items.teaser: As the United States approaches its November midterms, concerns about the integrity of the election process are escalating, with a signif…
items.story:
As the United States approaches its November midterms, concerns about the integrity of the election process are escalating, with a significant majority of Americans expressing fears that the outcome could be compromised. According to recent polling data from the Charles F. Kettering Foundation and Gallup, many citizens are worried about the potential for political pressure to alter results or for election officials to mishandle ballots. The fears are widespread, with most Americans doubting the fairness and security of the electoral system. This growing unease is likely to impact voter turnout and confidence in the democratic process.

The current concerns about election integrity are not new, but they have been exacerbated by unfounded claims about the 2020 presidential election, which have been repeatedly made by former President Donald Trump. Trump's assertions that the election was stolen from him have been thoroughly debunked, but they have contributed to a pervasive sense of mistrust among his supporters. Critics of Trump argue that his claims and efforts to reshape the electoral system are undermining the foundations of American democracy. The controversy surrounding election integrity has been fueled by partisan divisions and the increasing polarization of American politics.

Gallup's polling data reveals that a substantial majority of Americans are worried about the potential for election results to be altered by political pressure or mishandling by officials. The survey found that most citizens are concerned about the fairness and security of the electoral process, with many doubting the ability of election officials to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the results. The data also suggests that these concerns are not limited to one party or ideology, but are widespread across the American electorate. Experts warn that these fears could have significant implications for voter turnout and the legitimacy of the election outcome.

The growing concerns about election integrity are having a significant impact on the public's perception of the democratic process. Many stakeholders, including election officials, civil rights groups, and political leaders, are responding to these fears by calling for increased transparency and security measures to ensure the integrity of the electoral system. Some states are implementing new voting laws and procedures, while others are investing in election security and voter education initiatives. The reactions to these concerns reflect the deepening divisions and mistrust that are characteristic of contemporary American politics.

The controversy surrounding election integrity in the United States has significant implications for the country's democratic system and its global reputation. The concerns about the fairness and security of the electoral process are not unique to the United States, but they are particularly pronounced in the American context. The global community is watching the developments in the United States with interest, as the country's democratic system is often seen as a model for other nations. The ongoing debates about election integrity are likely to have regional and global implications, as they reflect broader trends and challenges in democratic governance.

As the November midterms approach, the concerns about election integrity are likely to continue, with many Americans remaining skeptical about the fairness and security of the electoral process. The outcome of the elections will depend on a range of factors, including voter turnout, campaign strategies, and the effectiveness of election officials. In the coming weeks and months, voters, policymakers, and election officials will be watching closely to see how these concerns are addressed and what steps are taken to ensure the integrity of the democratic process. The future of American democracy may depend on the ability of its leaders to restore trust and confidence in the electoral system.

Israeli forces have intensified their raids and settler attacks across the occupied West Bank, resulting in increased tensions and violence in the region. The West Bank has been under Israeli occupation since 1967, and the ongoing conflict has led to a significant escalation in recent months. The situation on the ground remains volatile, with both Israeli and Palestinian leaders calling for calm and restraint.

The occupied West Bank has a long and complex history, with the Israeli-Palestinian conflict dating back to the early 20th century. The ongoing raids and settler attacks have further complicated the situation, making a peaceful resolution more elusive.

The Israeli military has stated that the operations are aimed at targeting militant groups and preventing attacks on Israeli civilians. However, Palestinian officials have denounced the raids as a form of collective punishment, arguing that they only serve to exacerbate the situation. The United Nations has also expressed concern over the rising tensions, calling on both sides to exercise restraint and respect human rights. The international community has urged Israel to halt its settlement expansion and to work towards a peaceful resolution to the conflict.

The Palestinian economy has also suffered, with many businesses forced to close due to the ongoing unrest. The international community has called for an end to the occupation and the establishment of a sovereign Palestinian state, but a lasting solution remains elusive. The ongoing conflict in the West Bank has significant regional and global implications. The international community has expressed concern over the potential for the conflict to spread beyond the region, with many fearing a wider conflagration. The United States, the European Union, and other major powers have all called for a peaceful resolution to the conflict, but a lasting solution remains elusive. As the situation in the West Bank continues to deteriorate, many are left wondering what the future holds for the region. The international community is likely to continue to play a key role in efforts to resolve the conflict, with many calling for a renewed push for a peaceful resolution. items.story:

items.headline: Saudi Arabia Announces Strategic Partnership to Safeguard Vital Maritime Trade Routes.

items.story:
Saudi Arabia is forming a coalition to protect the Red Sea from attacks by Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, a move that aims to defend shipping lanes and ensure the safe passage of vessels through the critical waterway. The alliance is being established in response to a series of attacks on oil tankers and other ships in the Red Sea, which have been blamed on the Houthi rebels. The coalition's formation is seen as a significant development in the region, where tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran have been escalating in recent years. The Red Sea is a vital shipping route, with millions of barrels of oil passing through it every day, and any disruption to traffic could have major implications for the global economy.

The background to the coalition's formation lies in the ongoing conflict in Yemen, where the Houthi rebels have been fighting against the government and its allies, including Saudi Arabia, since 2015. The Houthis have been accused of carrying out numerous attacks on shipping in the Red Sea, including the use of missiles and drones to target oil tankers and other vessels. These attacks have raised concerns about the safety of shipping in the region and have prompted Saudi Arabia and its allies to take action to protect their interests. The coalition is seen as a way to coordinate efforts to defend against these attacks and to ensure the continued flow of oil and other goods through the Red Sea.

The coalition is expected to include several countries from the region, including Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, and Jordan, as well as other nations that have an interest in protecting shipping in the Red Sea. According to officials, the coalition will work to share intelligence and coordinate efforts to defend against attacks, and will also provide training and support to countries in the region to help them build their own capacity to protect their shipping lanes. The coalition's efforts will be focused on protecting the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical waterway that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and is a major shipping route. Officials have stated that the coalition's goal is to ensure the safe passage of vessels through the strait and to prevent any disruption to shipping in the region.

The formation of the coalition has been welcomed by many countries, including the United States, which has expressed concern about the threat posed by the Houthi rebels to shipping in the Red Sea. The US has been working closely with Saudi Arabia and its allies to address the issue and has provided support for efforts to protect shipping in the region. The impact of the coalition's formation is expected to be significant, with many analysts predicting that it will help to reduce the risk of attacks on shipping in the Red Sea and to ensure the continued flow of oil and other goods through the region. The coalition's efforts are also expected to have a positive impact on the global economy, by reducing the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and helping to keep oil prices stable.

The wider context of the coalition's formation is the ongoing tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran, which have been escalating in recent years. The two countries have been competing for influence in the region and have been backing different sides in the conflict in Yemen. The coalition's formation is seen as a way for Saudi Arabia to counter Iranian influence in the region and to protect its own interests. The move is also expected to have implications for the global balance of power, with many analysts predicting that it will strengthen Saudi Arabia's position in the region and help to counter Iranian influence. The coalition's formation is also expected to have implications for the conflict in Yemen, where the Houthis have been fighting against the government and its allies for several years.

The coalition's success will depend on its ability to coordinate efforts and to build a strong partnership between its member countries, as well as its ability to address the root causes of the conflict in Yemen and to find a lasting solution to the crisis.

items.headline: Researchers warn of escalating risks as calls mount for AI development speed limits.
items.teaser: Leading artificial intelligence labs in the United States are approaching a critical juncture, as a growing consensus emerges that the ra…
items.story:
Leading artificial intelligence labs in the United States are approaching a critical juncture, as a growing consensus emerges that the rapid pace of progress in the field may necessitate a slowdown to ensure safety and responsible development. This convergence of opinion among AI architects has been driven by a series of extraordinary breakthroughs over the summer, which have sparked both awe and concern among experts and the general public. As a result, momentum is building for a pause or pacing mechanism to be implemented, with over 1,200 employees from prominent AI companies signing a petition to urge the US government to support an international framework. The petition, titled "Pacing the Frontier," highlights the need for a coordinated approach to regulating the development of AI. This development marks a significant shift in the debate surrounding AI, as industry leaders and experts begin to prioritize caution and responsibility over unchecked innovation.

The notion of slowing down AI development may seem counterintuitive, given the significant investments and advancements made in the field in recent years. However, the rapid pace of progress has raised concerns about the potential risks and unintended consequences of creating increasingly sophisticated AI systems. Experts have long warned about the dangers of creating autonomous systems that may surpass human intelligence, potentially leading to unpredictable and uncontrollable outcomes. The recent breakthroughs have brought these concerns to the forefront, prompting a reevaluation of the priorities and goals of AI research. As the AI community grapples with these challenges, the need for a coordinated and regulated approach to development has become increasingly apparent.

According to the petition, the signatories represent a broad range of AI companies and research institutions, including some of the most prominent players in the field. The petition calls for the establishment of an international framework to regulate AI development, with a focus on ensuring safety, transparency, and accountability. The proposed framework would provide a set of guidelines and standards for AI research, as well as mechanisms for monitoring and enforcing compliance. While the petition does not specify the exact nature of the pacing mechanism, it emphasizes the need for a coordinated approach to regulating AI development, rather than relying on individual companies or institutions to self-regulate.

The reaction to the petition has been largely positive, with many experts and industry leaders welcoming the call for a more responsible and regulated approach to AI development. However, some have expressed concerns about the potential impact on innovation and competitiveness, arguing that a slowdown could cede ground to other countries or companies that may be less concerned with safety and ethics. The petition has also sparked a broader debate about the role of government in regulating AI, with some arguing that a more active role is needed to ensure public safety and others advocating for a more hands-off approach. As the debate continues, it remains to be seen how the US government and other countries will respond to the call for an international framework.

The growing momentum for an AI pause or pacing mechanism has significant implications for the global AI community, as well as for the broader public. As AI systems become increasingly integrated into daily life, the need for safety and accountability has become more pressing. The development of an international framework would require cooperation and agreement among multiple countries and stakeholders, a challenging task given the complex and rapidly evolving nature of the field. However, the alternative – a lack of regulation and oversight – could lead to unforeseen and potentially catastrophic consequences. items.headline: Nine Fatalities Result from Catastrophic Fire on March 18, Blamed on Equipment Malfunction.
items.teaser: Nine people lost their lives in a devastating blaze that occurred on March 18, with investigations revealing that a Bronto Skylift failed…
items.story:
Nine people lost their lives in a devastating blaze that occurred on March 18, with investigations revealing that a Bronto Skylift failed to function properly and the crew operating it had not received adequate training. The incident has raised serious concerns about safety protocols and emergency preparedness in the region. Authorities have launched a thorough probe into the matter, seeking to determine the exact causes of the tragedy and identify measures to prevent such incidents in the future. The victims' families and loved ones are still grappling with the aftermath of the disaster, seeking answers and justice.

The use of Bronto Skylifts is common in various industries, including construction, firefighting, and rescue operations, due to their ability to reach high areas and navigate complex terrain. However, the equipment requires specialized training and regular maintenance to ensure safe operation. In this case, the failure of the Bronto Skylift and the lack of proper training among the crew have been cited as key factors contributing to the tragic outcome. The incident serves as a stark reminder of the importance of adhering to safety standards and providing personnel with the necessary skills and knowledge to operate complex equipment.

According to official reports, the Bronto Skylift in question had been inspected and certified prior to the incident, but a subsequent investigation revealed that critical safety features had been compromised. Experts have pointed out that the crew's inadequate training and experience with the equipment likely exacerbated the situation, leading to a delayed and ineffective response to the emergency. The exact circumstances surrounding the blaze and the events leading up to it are still being investigated, with authorities reviewing witness statements, equipment logs, and other relevant data.

The incident has sparked widespread outrage and concern among local residents, who are demanding greater accountability and transparency from the authorities and the companies involved. Families of the victims have called for a comprehensive inquiry into the matter, seeking justice and compensation for their losses. The tragedy has also prompted a broader discussion about workplace safety and the need for enhanced training and equipment maintenance protocols across various industries. As the investigation continues, stakeholders are watching closely to see how the authorities and companies respond to the crisis.

The implications of this incident extend beyond the local community, highlighting the need for standardized safety protocols and training programs across regions and industries. Experts warn that similar tragedies could occur elsewhere if adequate measures are not taken to address the root causes of such incidents. The incident has also raised questions about regulatory oversight and the effectiveness of current safety frameworks in preventing accidents and ensuring accountability. As the world becomes increasingly interconnected, the importance of sharing best practices and lessons learned from such incidents cannot be overstated.

As the investigation into the March 18 blaze continues, authorities are expected to release further findings and recommendations in the coming weeks. The families of the victims and the wider community will be watching closely to see how the incident is addressed and what measures are taken to prevent similar tragedies in the future. The incident serves as a poignant reminder of the importance of prioritizing safety and accountability, and the need for ongoing efforts to improve emergency preparedness and response protocols. In the months and years ahead, it will be crucial to monitor the progress made in addressing these concerns and ensuring that such a devastating incident never happens again.

items.headline: Kerala High Court Orders MLA to Respond to Election Irregularity Allegations
items.teaser: The Kerala High Court has issued a notice to Payyannur MLA V Kunhikrishnan, seeking his response to an election petition that alleges he …
items.story:
The Kerala High Court has issued a notice to Payyannur MLA V Kunhikrishnan, seeking his response to an election petition that alleges he engaged in malpractice during the polls by spreading false propaganda against his rival candidate. This development comes as a significant step in the ongoing case, which has been closely watched by political observers and the public alike. The court's decision to seek a response from the MLA indicates that it is taking the allegations seriously and is willing to examine the evidence presented. The petition, which was filed shortly after the election results were announced, claims that Kunhikrishnan's actions were in violation of the electoral code of conduct.

The election in question was a closely contested one, with Kunhikrishnan emerging as the winner by a narrow margin. The petitioner, who was the rival candidate, has alleged that Kunhikrishnan's campaign engaged in a systematic effort to spread false and misleading information about them, which ultimately influenced the outcome of the election. This is not the first time that allegations of election malpractice have been raised in Kerala, and the case has sparked a wider debate about the need for greater transparency and accountability in the electoral process. The court's decision to hear the petition is seen as a positive step towards addressing these concerns and ensuring that the electoral process is fair and free from manipulation.

According to the petition, Kunhikrishnan's campaign made several false claims about the rival candidate, including allegations of corruption and misconduct. The petitioner has submitted evidence, including audio and video recordings, to support their claims. The court has asked Kunhikrishnan to respond to the allegations and provide an explanation for the actions of his campaign. The MLA has not yet commented publicly on the matter, but his lawyers are expected to file a response to the petition in the coming days. The court will then review the response and decide whether to proceed with the case.

The case has sparked a reaction from political parties and civil society groups, who are calling for greater accountability and transparency in the electoral process. The opposition party has demanded that the government take action to prevent election malpractice and ensure that the electoral process is fair and free from manipulation. The ruling party, on the other hand, has maintained that the allegations are baseless and that the election was conducted in a fair and transparent manner. The public is also closely watching the case, with many taking to social media to express their opinions and concerns about the electoral process.

The case has wider implications for the electoral process in Kerala and beyond. If the court finds that Kunhikrishnan's campaign engaged in election malpractice, it could set a precedent for future cases and lead to greater scrutiny of electoral campaigns. The case also highlights the need for greater transparency and accountability in the electoral process, including the need for more effective mechanisms to prevent election malpractice. The outcome of the case will be closely watched by political observers and the public alike, and is expected to have a significant impact on the political landscape in Kerala.

The next step in the case will be for Kunhikrishnan to file a response to the petition, which is expected to happen in the coming days. The court will then review the response and decide whether to proceed with the case. If the court finds that there is sufficient evidence to support the allegations, it could lead to further action, including a possible recount or even the disqualification of the MLA. The outcome of the case will be closely watched, and is expected to have significant implications for the electoral process in Kerala and beyond.

items.story: ഐഐടി മദ്രാസ് ഡയറക്ടർ ‘ഗോമൂത്ര വിദഗ്ധൻ’; പ്രിയങ്കയ്ക്കെതിരെ പ്രതിഷേധവുമായി 215 അക്കാഡമിക് വിദഗ്ധർ mangalam.com‘ഗോമൂത്രവിദഗ്ധൻ’ പരാമർശം; 'പാണ്ഡിത്യത്തെ അപമാനിക്കരുത്', പ്രിയങ്ക ഗാന്ധിക്ക് കത്തെഴുതി വിദഗ്ധർ Mathrubhumi‘സമിതിയിൽ ഗോമൂത്ര വിദഗ്ധനും’: പരിഹസിച്ച് പ്രിയങ്ക ഗാന്ധി; ആർഎസ്എസിൽ ചേർന്ന് മൂല്യങ്ങൾ പഠിക്കണമെന്ന് അനുരാഗ് ഠാക്കൂർ Manorama Onlineപ്രിയങ്ക ഗാന്ധി 'ഗോമൂത്ര വിദഗ്ധൻ' എന്ന് വിളിച്ച IIT മദ്രാസ് ഡയറക്ടർ കാമകോടി ആരാണ്? items.headline: ADGP എസ്. ശ്രീജിത്തിന് വൻ തിരിച്ചടി: ചീഫ് സെക്രട്ടറിയുടെ ക്ലീൻചിറ്റ് റിപ്പോർട്ട് ഹൈക്കോടതി റദ്ദാക്കി
items.teaser: ADGP എസ്. ശ്രീജിത്തിന് വൻ തിരിച്ചടി: ചീഫ് സെക്രട്ടറിയുടെ ക്ലീൻചിറ്റ് റിപ്പോർട്ട് ഹൈക്കോടതി റദ്ദാക്കി Mathrubhumiഅനുമതിയില്ലാതെ വിദേശയാത്ര…
items.story: ADGP എസ്. ശ്രീജിത്തിന് വൻ തിരിച്ചടി: ചീഫ് സെക്രട്ടറിയുടെ ക്ലീൻചിറ്റ് റിപ്പോർട്ട് ഹൈക്കോടതി റദ്ദാക്കി Mathrubhumiഅനുമതിയില്ലാതെ വിദേശയാത്ര: എഡിജിപി എസ്.ശ്രീജിത്തിനു നൽകിയ ക്ലീൻ ചിറ്റ് റദ്ദാക്കി ഹൈക്കോടതി Manorama Onlineഎഡിജിപി എസ് ശ്രീജിത്തിന് തിരിച്ചടി; അനുമതിയില്ലാതെ വിദേശയാത്ര, ചീഫ് സെക്രട്ടറിയുടെ റിപ്പോർട്ട് റദ്ദാക്കി ഹൈക്കോടതി, സംരക്ഷിച്ചതിന് വിമർശനം Asianet News Malayalamഎസ്. ശ്രീജിത്തിന്റെ വിദേശയാത്ര: അനുമതി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുവെന്ന് റിപ്പോർട്ട്, പുനർവിചാരണയ്ക്ക് ഉത്തരവ് Mathrubhumiഎസ് ശ്രീജിത്ത

items.story: 'ടൈമിങ്ങാണ് പ്രധാനം'; വിരമിക്കല്‍ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച് രഹാനെ, കളമൊഴിഞ്ഞത് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ വിശ്വസ്തനായ ടെസ്റ്റ് ബാറ്റര്‍ Samakalika Malayalam36 റൺസ് ഓൾ ഔട്ട്, നാണക്കേടിൽ കോലിയും കൈവിട്ടു, ഇന്ത്യൻ ടീമിനെ രക്ഷിച്ച അജിൻക്യ, ക്യാപ്റ്റൻസിയിൽ ‘രണ്ടാമൂഴം’ മാത്രം Manorama Onlineതിരിച്ചുവരവുകളിൽ ഹീറോ, ടീം ഇന്ത്യയുടെ 'ഓവർസീസ് സ്പെഷ്യലിസ്റ്റ്'; ‘ടൈമിങ്’ സ്‌പെഷൽ രഹാനെ Mathrubhumiപരാജയമറിയാത്ത നായകന്‍; അജിന്‍ക്യ രഹാനെ പടിയിറങ്ങുന്നത് അപൂര്‍വ്വ റെക്കോര്‍ഡുകളോടെ Asianet News Malayalamഎല്ലാത്തിനും ഒരു തുടക്കവും ഒടുക്കവുമുണ്
